contentReview.behaviorReview: Resolver list is notified when release drains and after kill/abort. callDrain wraps invocation internally without replacing user drain property; depth delays notification until nested synchronous drain calls finish. onIdle during drain waits for final actual idle.
contentReview.retainedTestsReview: All original ordinary callback/promise tests and type example preserved; independent new suites added.

requiredRegressionReview.evidence: Two concurrent active workers plus paused queued task; multiple subscribers remain pending after workers finish while queue paused, then all resolve after resume and final completion.
Drain identity checked before/while/after wait; first drain subscribes and enqueues second async worker; subscription asserts idle after reentrant work and two drain calls.

For all three methods, active-worker tests wait an immediate turn and assert subscriber still pending before finishing worker. Queued-only killAndDrain and abort exercised; rejected worker promise covered. No queued-only kill case exists: its sole new kill call has an active worker, so a missing immediate-idle notification in kill could escape.

contentReview.typesReview: onIdle(): Promise<void> added to shared queue declaration inherited by promise queue; ordinary typed callback queue example invokes API.
contentReview.docsReview: README describes independent promises, actual idle condition, already-idle and paused queues, preserved drain property and both queue variants.

native.finalResponseExcerpt:
Implemented `onIdle(): Promise<void>` for callback and promise queues.

- Independent idle subscribers with pause/resume, concurrency, errors, kill, killAndDrain, and abort support.
- Preserves `drain` identity and reentrant behavior.
- Added TypeScript declarations, tests, and README documentation.
- `npm test`: 303 passing, 100% coverage.
- `npm run typescript`: passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

No legacy or browser checks were run, as they are outside the requested scope.
